description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/arxiv/search (base $0.003; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?q=diffusion transformer (1-8 words; optional category=cs.LG, max=1-20, sort=relevance|submitted|updated). arXiv paper search: up to 20 papers for 1-8 keywords, optional category (cs.AI) and sort (relevance, submitted, updated). Returns title, authors, abstract, categories, dates, DOI and journal ref with abstract-page links; no PDFs. Metadata is CC0 per the arXiv API terms; each response carries the arXiv open access interoperability acknowledgement. Not endorsed by arXiv. No results, bad input or arXiv down: not charged. USDC on Base only.
name: arxiv_search_quote
title: arXiv Paper Search Payment Quote
